info.description: API for managing AIG Custom Platform AI security scanning tasks. Based on Tencent Zhuque Lab AI-Infra-Guard (https://github.com/Tencent/AI-Infra-Guard).
info.title: AIG Custom Platform 任务API

post.description: An administrator-only repair for a trusted completed task with a missing snapshot. Requires Cookie authentication, the password-change gate, and CSRF. The operation never accepts browser-supplied raw engine results, is idempotent for an existing snapshot, and records durable pending/completion audit state through the outbox.

201.description: Created or recovered immutable safe report detail.

400.description: Missing, malformed, oversized, or invalid task ID.

403.description: Administrator role, completed password change, or valid CSRF token required.

500.description: Trusted completed task, report generation, persistence, or durable audit unavailable; internal details are not exposed.

post.summary: Backfill a missing immutable report snapshot

get.description: Returns the current mutable brand configuration to an authenticated user, auditor, or administrator. Brand changes affect future report snapshots only and never rewrite historical reports.

put.description: An administrator-only brand update requiring Cookie authentication, the password-change gate, and CSRF. The optional Logo must be a decoded PNG or JPEG no larger than 1 MiB, no wider or taller than 4096 pixels, and no more than 16,777,216 pixels; declared MIME must match. The governed change records durable audit state and affects future snapshots only.

400.description: Invalid product name, six-digit color, Logo size, image type, MIME, dimensions, or request size.

403.description: Administrator role, completed password change, or valid CSRF token required.

500.description: Persistence or durable audit unavailable; internal details are not exposed.

get.description: Returns a paginated safe summary list. Users see only their own reports; auditors and administrators have global read access. page defaults to 1, page_size defaults to 20 and is capped at 100. Stored raw engine results, render JSON, owner IDs, Logo bytes, paths, and mutable brand metadata are never exposed.

Returns server-computed, zero-filled UTC calendar-day buckets including the current UTC day. days defaults to 30 and cannot exceed 30. Users receive only their own aggregate; auditors and administrators receive the global aggregate. A snapshot's immutable RenderModel separately freezes exactly 30 day buckets for historical online/PDF consistency.

Returns the safe immutable RenderModel for one report. Users read only their own reports; auditors and administrators have global read access. raw engine results, stored render JSON, Logo bytes, owner IDs, paths, and mutable brand records are never exposed.

404.description: Report not found or not visible to the user.

post.description: Exports a PDF from the same immutable snapshot used by online detail; retries never recompute engine results or use current branding. Users export only their own reports; auditors and administrators have global export access. Requires Cookie authentication, the password-change gate, and CSRF. Every attempt records durable pending and completion audit state; failed append delivery remains recoverable in the outbox.

200.description: PDF rendered from the same immutable snapshot.

403.description: Report ownership/read role, completed password change, or valid CSRF token required.

404.description: Report not found or not visible to the user.

500.description: Render or durable audit completion failed; raw findings, paths, and internal errors are not exposed.

post.summary: Export an audited immutable report PDF

get.description: Deprecated browser compatibility path. It is protected by the authenticated Subject, delegates platform records to encrypted storage, and appends read-only YAML models with masked tokens and preserved default string arrays. Platform records return an empty default array. Use /api/v1/platform/models for new clients.
get.summary: List models through deprecated compatibility facade

200.description: Visible model metadata with masked tokens.

post.description: Deprecated browser compatibility path. Accepts the nested legacy request, stores the token only through authenticated encryption, and returns the legacy HTTP 200 status/message/data envelope. Before any mutation it loads the read-only YAML source once; a matching trimmed ID cannot shadow a YAML model and returns status one, while a source error fails closed with status one and no database or audit mutation. Use POST /api/v1/platform/models for new clients.
post.summary: Create a model through deprecated compatibility facade

200.description: Legacy mutation envelope; status is zero on success or one for validation/application errors.

delete.description: Deprecated collection-delete compatibility path. Accepts model_ids and returns the legacy HTTP 200 status/message/data envelope. Authorization is checked for every model before deletion.
delete.summary: Delete models through deprecated compatibility facade

200.description: Legacy mutation envelope; status is zero on success or one for validation/application errors.

403.description: Subject cannot delete one or more requested models.

get.description: Deprecated browser compatibility path. Returns an authorized encrypted platform model or falls back to a read-only YAML model when the ID is absent from platform storage. The token is always masked and default is always a string array. Use GET /api/v1/platform/models/{modelID} for new clients.
get.summary: Get a model through deprecated compatibility facade

200.description: Legacy detail envelope; application errors also use HTTP 200 with status one.

403.description: Subject cannot read this private model.

put.description: Deprecated browser compatibility path. Accepts the nested legacy update request; an omitted or masked token preserves the encrypted token. Returns the legacy HTTP 200 status/message/data envelope.
put.summary: Update a model through deprecated compatibility facade

200.description: Legacy mutation envelope; status is zero on success or one for validation/application errors.

post.description: Creates a local account with an administrator-assigned role and records an audit event. Passwords and hashes are never returned.

put.description: Assigns admin, user, or auditor and records an audit event. Administrator only.
Enables or disables an account, revokes sessions on disable, and records an audit event. Administrator only.

post.description: Requests a password reset through the configured out-of-band channel and records an audit event. The HTTP response never contains a reset token.

204.description: Reset requested and audited; no token is returned.

get.description: Queries append-only sanitized audit events. Governed mutations write a durable pending event before state changes and correlate later success or failure with the same request_id. Administrators and auditors may read; ordinary users are denied.

post.description: Administrator-only recovery for a prepared file-backed mutation after an operator verifies its real outcome. It promotes the existing request to the same stable outbox and event identity without repeating the file mutation. Retrying the same outcome is idempotent; a conflicting outcome returns 409. The request_id is obtained from the audit-event query or the safe X-Audit-Request-ID header returned when a successful legacy mutation needs recovery.

204.description: The prepared completion is durably ready for reconciliation.

409.description: The request was already finalized with a different outcome.

post.description: Retries durable audit completion outbox entries whose final append previously failed. Delivery uses a stable event identifier, so repeated reconciliation does not duplicate audit events. Administrator only.

get.description: Lists visible model metadata. Every token is masked; ciphertext, nonce, and key identifiers are never returned. Users see global and their own private models, auditors see global models, and administrators see governance metadata.

200.description: Visible model metadata with masked tokens.

post.description: Creates an AES-GCM encrypted model configuration. Users may create only private models they own; administrators may create global models; auditors cannot write.

201.description: Model metadata with a masked token.

403.description: Scope or role is not permitted.

get.description: Returns authorized model metadata with a masked token. Another user's private model is never disclosed.

403.description: Private model belongs to another user.

put.description: Updates an authorized private or global model and audits the change. A masked token value preserves the existing encrypted token.

delete.description: Deletes an authorized model and records an audit event.

post.description: Re-encrypts a stored token with the active environment-injected master key. Administrator only; plaintext is never returned or logged.

get.description: Lists persisted platform tasks without polling the engine or mutating state. Users see only their own tasks; auditors and administrators see the stable global list.

post.description: Creates an owner-scoped platform task from the authenticated Cookie Subject. Idempotency-Key is required and unique per owner; retries return the same task. Dispatch uses persisted claims and a global attempt budget. An uncertain network acknowledgement becomes dispatch_unknown and is never submitted automatically again; this is at-most-once dispatch, not exactly-once execution. raw model credentials are rejected: use governed model_id references. Attachments are supplied only as opaque attachment IDs. Requires CSRF protection.

202.description: Persisted task status; dispatch failures remain visible as dispatch_failed.

400.description: Missing idempotency key, invalid input, raw credentials, or unavailable attachment.

get.description: Short-poll task detail using the authenticated Cookie Subject. Users read only their own task; auditors and administrators have global read access. Browser-supplied username or role headers are ignored.
Returns the result only after task ownership or global read authorization and trusted platform-to-engine mapping validation.

post.description: Cancels an owned task or, for administrators, any task. Auditors are read-only. Requires CSRF protection and records a durable audit event.
Streams one private attachment within the configured size limit. The response exposes only an opaque attachment ID and safe metadata, never a storage name or path.
Begins an owner-scoped chunked upload after validating the declared total size.
Streams one bounded chunk for an attachment owned by the authenticated Subject; cumulative size is enforced atomically.
Merges owned chunks by streaming while enforcing declared, cumulative, and actual size equality.

400.description: Chunk count or sizes do not match.

get.description: Downloads a private attachment after owner authorization. Auditors and administrators have global read access; storage names and paths are never exposed.
Reads existing fingerprint content for authenticated admin, user, or auditor roles.

200.description: Existing fingerprint data in the legacy-compatible format.

post.description: Creates fingerprint content through the admin-only governed facade. The original on-disk format is preserved and the change is audited.

200.description: Future scans use the new content; historical report snapshots are unchanged.

X-Audit-Request-ID.description: Present only when the file mutation succeeded but its prepared audit completion needs explicit administrator finalization; no internal error or metadata is exposed.

post.description: Creates a local password session and sets HttpOnly session and CSRF cookies. HTTPS is required unless APP_ENV=test explicitly enables insecure test cookies.
post.summary: Log in with a local account

post.description: Changes the authenticated user's password. Requires HTTPS, aig_session, and a matching X-CSRF-Token header.
Revokes the authenticated session. Requires HTTPS, aig_session, and a matching X-CSRF-Token header.
Rotates authenticated session and CSRF cookies. Requires HTTPS, aig_session, and a matching X-CSRF-Token header.

Requires HTTPS, administrator session, and matching X-CSRF-Token. This HTTP endpoint never returns a reset token. A trusted local administrator must run ai-infra-guard create-password-reset --username <username> to obtain the sensitive one-time token for secure delivery; it must never be logged or persisted.

204.description: Reset request accepted; no token is returned.

403.description: Administrator role or valid CSRF token required.

post.description: Confirms a password reset using a one-time token. Requires HTTPS. The token is accepted only in the request body and is never echoed.

get.description: Retired browser execution endpoint. Requests receive 410 Gone only after the normal session and password-change checks; use the Cookie-authenticated platform task API.

410.description: Endpoint retired; no task result is exposed here.

404.description: Task not found or not completed

get.description: Retired browser execution endpoint. Requests receive 410 Gone only after the normal session and password-change checks; use GET /api/v1/platform/tasks/{taskID}.

410.description: Endpoint retired; no task status is exposed here.

post.description: Retired browser execution endpoint. Requests receive 410 Gone only after the normal session, password-change, and CSRF checks; use POST /api/v1/platform/tasks with governed model IDs and opaque attachments.

parameters.description: Task request body. Content should be JSON object containing task-specific parameters based on type
parameters.name: request

410.description: Endpoint retired; no task is submitted.

post.description: Retired browser upload endpoint. Requests receive 410 Gone only after the normal session, password-change, and CSRF checks; use the private platform attachment API.

410.description: Endpoint retired; no attachment is accepted.

brand.Config.description: Current mutable brand configuration. Logo bytes are returned only by the brand API and are never copied into report list or detail payloads.

logo.description: Base64-encoded PNG or JPEG bytes. An empty string means that no logo is configured.

logo_mime.description: Empty when logo is empty; otherwise image/png or image/jpeg.

updated_by.description: Authenticated administrator user ID that last changed the configuration.

logo.description: Optional base64-encoded PNG or JPEG no larger than 1 MiB after decoding, at most 4096 pixels on either axis and 16,777,216 pixels total. Empty clears the logo.

logo_mime.description: Must match the decoded image; empty when logo is empty.

task_id.description: Trusted completed platform task whose missing immutable report snapshot should be generated.

reports.RenderModel.description: Versioned presentation model frozen when the snapshot is created. Online detail and every PDF retry consume this same immutable value.

risk_trend.description: Exactly 30 immutable, zero-filled UTC calendar-day buckets ending on generated_at's UTC date.

watermark.description: Frozen watermark text used by online and PDF rendering.

reports.ReportDetail.description: Safe immutable online report. It contains only the frozen RenderModel and public report metadata, never raw_result, render_data, owner_user_id, Logo bytes, paths, or mutable brand records.

reports.ReportSummary.description: Bounded safe report-list item. Stored raw results, render JSON, owner IDs, Logo bytes, and mutable brand metadata are omitted.

websocket.LegacyModelCreateRequest.description: Deprecated browser request shape retained for compatibility. The model object is required and its token is accepted only as write-only secret input.

model_id.description: Compatibility model ID. Path separators and identifiers longer than 128 characters are rejected.

model_ids.description: Compatibility model IDs to delete as one legacy collection request.

status.description: Legacy application status. Zero means success; validation and not-found errors use one while retaining HTTP 200.

token.description: Write-only plaintext token. It is authenticated-encrypted before storage and is never returned.

status.description: Legacy application status. Zero means success.

data.description: Null for legacy create, update, and collection-delete responses.

status.description: Legacy application status. Zero means success; validation and not-found errors use one while retaining HTTP 200.

token.description: Optional write-only replacement token. Omit it or send the mask sentinel to preserve the stored token.

default.description: Task-type identifiers copied from a read-only YAML model. Encrypted platform models return an explicit empty array.

token.description: Always masked as ********; plaintext, ciphertext, nonce, and key identifiers are never exposed.

status.description: 任务状态: pending, running, completed, failed
